newsitem.title: USA: North American grain weather highlights - WSC.
newsitem.headline: North American grain weather highlights - WSC.

text.p: Following are weather forecasts by independent forecaster Weather Services Corporation.

NORTH AMERICA...The remnants of Fran spread a deluge of heavy rains through portions of the Mid Atlantic, far eastern Midwest, and Northeastern USA this period. Scattered showers and thunderstorms continue in the eastern cornbelt this period. Clearing and cooler in the Prairies this period. All interests in the northeastern Caribbean continue to monitor Tropical Storm Fran with 55-60 mph winds. Heavy rains of up to 10.00 inches could produce flash flooding.
US Southern Plains- Generally fair weather.
US Midwest- Showers and thunderstorms track into the eastern belt.
US Northern Plains- Chance of a few showers on Tuesday.
Canadian Prairies- Clearing and quite cool.
Midwest- Showers and thunderstorms move into the eastern belt this period.
Midwest- Showers and thunderstorms advance into the eastern belt.
US Southern Plains- No widespread rain.
